steps.prompt_exact: I’m turning a messy food-blog recipe into a handoff sheet: make me one browser file I can save and open offline on my phone where I enter a recipe name, servings, ingredients, prep notes, and dietary flags, then scale portions and print or copy clean yield cards plus a tiny grocery grouping.
